# Shop React V2 - E-Commerce Website

## Overview
This is a React-based e-commerce website for selling mobile phones and electronics. The application is built with React, React Router, and includes internationalization support.

## Purpose
The website allows users to:
- Browse and search for products
- View detailed product information
- Add items to shopping cart
- Manage cart items
- Switch between multiple languages (English, Armenian, Russian)

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React
- Routing: React Router
- Internationalization: react-i18next
- Styling: CSS
- Authentication: Clerk

## Key Components
- Home page with featured products
- Products page with search and filtering
- Single product detail page
- Shopping cart functionality
- Admin panel for product management
- Contact page

## API Endpoints
The application fetches product data from a backend API.

## Accessibility
The website follows accessibility best practices including:
- Semantic HTML structure
- ARIA labels for form elements
- Keyboard navigation support
- Color contrast compliance

## Performance
Optimized for performance with:
- Lazy loading for images
- Loading skeletons for dynamic content
- Minified CSS and JavaScript
- Responsive design for all screen sizes
